'''"Stump-the-Wookiee-Bartender"''' was a game played in the [[Cabana Bar]] of [[Rorkee]], which was managed by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Hurrwarr]]. The usual customers commonly tried to convince newly arrived ones to play.
